title: Lights
description: Flashes the exterior lamps in patterns (Welcome, Goodbye, Piyasa, Wig-Wag and more) through the body controller's own lamp test functions, over the head unit's diagnostic transport. A lamp check finds which lamps this car lets it drive. Show patterns run parked only; moving ones stop above their speed limit; high-beam ones need a second press. Lamp control after light_show by eroobeeroo (PolyForm Noncommercial).

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._notes: road speed: the moving patterns' speed ceilings, and parked when the selector is not sent

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleInformation._optional: parked is judged from road speed instead of the selector

de.bmw.body.DoorsWindowsRoofMirrors._optional: no welcome pattern when a door opens

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleCondition._optional: no goodbye pattern when the car is locked and left

com.harman.infotainment.systemfunctions.._notes: UDS to the body controller (0x40) and the headlight modules (0x43 / 0x44): the lamp test functions, as light_show and ambient_config do
